# Parse all notes to extract date and habit values
import re

parsed_notes = []
for note in notes:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    date = m.group(1)
    # Parse content: skip first line (header), then each line "habit: value"
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Find lines that contain ": "
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        if ': ' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(': ', 1)
            habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Print first note's habits to see order
print(parsed_notes[0]['date'], parsed_notes[0]['habits'])
# Check all notes have same set of habits
all_habits = list(parsed_notes[0]['habits'].keys())
print("Habit order:", all_habits)
for pn in parsed_notes:
    if list(pn['habits'].keys()) != all_habits:
        print("Mismatch in", pn['date'])
        break
else:
    print("All notes have same habit order")
